view: The trend is down on 1W, 1D and 4H. Price fell 22.9% in a week (7th straight weekly decline), closed below the 2024 range top 140.76 and the 2023 trendline (~140), and left a new gap at 143.725-145.71 overhead. Price now sits on the strongest support cluster on the chart: the 200W SMA 124.14, log fib 0.786 at 124.98, Friday's low 124.50 and linear fib 0.5 at 127.09. Weekly RSI 25.01 on a completed bar is genuinely oversold (below 30) for the first time in this sample. But the weekly and daily bars closed at their lows with no rejection wick, so I see a bounce-or-break setup at 122-128, not a confirmed low. I widen both tails and cut the range buckets.

probabilities.defs: 2w ±5%, quarters ±10%, vs price_at_call 125.53 (Fri 2026-11-20 close, weekend run). next_2_weeks: up > 131.81, down < 119.25, range between, measured at the close on or before 2026-12-06 (Fri 2026-12-04). this_quarter: close of 2026-12-31; next_quarter: close of 2027-03-31; up > 138.08, down < 112.98, range between. up + range + down = 100.

evidence.point: Base rate 33/45/22 (n=259) → 35/29/36. Range -16: daily ATR is 10.71 (8.5%), so the whole ±5% band (119.25-131.81, width 12.56) is only about 1.2 daily ATRs. Down +14: the trend is down on every timeframe and Friday closed 0.8% above its low on 3.9x the 60-day volume with no rejection wick. Up +2: the stretched-momentum conditionals below. Reach check: 131.81 by 2026-12-04 is 50.2%, 119.25 is 39.6%, so both tails are live.

Weekly RSI ≤36 (n=13, overlapping): 2w 46/23/31, median +3.2%; 13w 69/0/31, median +21.5%. The 13w distribution has no range outcomes, so it signals a large move either way, not a floor. RSI is now 25, well below the ≤36 condition, so even fewer past cases match. This is weak evidence, used only to keep up near 35 (2w) and 43 (next quarter).

The 2w change is -32.7%, more than twice the -15% condition. Results: 2w 50/50/0, 13w 100/0/0, median +32.1%, but n=4 overlapping windows (about one episode), and none matched a drop this deep. A sample this small cannot take the down bucket below about 30 when an accounting-review headline is driving the move.

Base rate 39/43/18 → 33/35/32. The up threshold 138.08 sits just under the new gap (143.725-145.71) and the broken 140.76/~140 trendline, so up means retaking most of Friday's -14% bar. The down threshold 112.98 lies about one ATR below the 200W SMA, so down means the 200W cluster fails. Reach by 2026-12-31: 138.08 is 52.7%, 112.98 is 36.4%. I keep it roughly symmetric.

Base rate 50/31/19 → 43/25/32. Over 13 weeks, the -48.4% drawdown, weekly RSI 25 and both conditionals pull toward up. Pulling toward down: seven straight weekly declines, price 28.3% below the 100W SMA, and the late-Feb 2027 earnings inside the window (a second binary event). Range is cut because ±10% is only about 1.2 daily ATRs on each side.

Weekly RSI14 is 25.01 (TradingView) / 25.0 (engine) on the COMPLETED bar of 2026-11-16, so is_oversold = true. This is the threshold check the lessons log (2026-11-11) asks for, and it passes this time. It is the lowest reading since 2023 (weekly RSI was only 35.7 at the Apr 2025 low). Weekly RSI7 11.78 and Stoch RSI 0/0 show extreme exhaustion. Oversold describes the state; it does not time the turn. I count it once, inside the momentum group.

Weekly candle: O 159.01, H 163.20, L 124.50, C 125.53 (-22.92%) on 2.05B shares. It closed within 1.03 of the low with almost no lower wick, the opposite of last week's 148.80 rejection wick. That is a bearish full-body bar: no sign of demand stepping in at the 200W SMA yet.

1W: MACD -8.14 below signal 1.97 (histogram -10.11, widening). Price is below SMA10/20/50 (201.53/208.34/198.71), EMA21 199.58, the 111W SMA 171.42 and the 100W SMA 174.97, and only 1.1% above the 200W SMA 124.14. Cipher B WT -22.3, BBPCT -33.29. Momentum group (1W/1D/4H) counted once.

1D: RSI14 15.05, RSI7 7.86, Stoch RSI 0/0, MACD -19.83 below signal -15.2. Price is 38.3% below the 200D SMA (203.35) and 20.8% below SMA10 158.44. Readings this extreme usually precede a reflex bounce within days, but the strength of a downtrend cannot be judged without ADX (see coverage). The BBPCT bottom triangles of Nov 10-13 failed: BBPCT is now -2.61 and price is 15% lower.

4H: RSI14 15.12, Stoch RSI 0/3.12, MACD -14.94 vs signal -13.3, last 4H close 125.83, 4H SMA200 209.99. Cipher B WT is +5.04 while price sits at the low, a small positive divergence and the only early turn hint. Information only.

Daily closes 162.85, 156.14, 155.46, 150.96, 145.98, 125.53. Trap rule outcomes: (1) the 2026-11-13 close below 164.27 was not reclaimed by 11-18, so that break is CONFIRMED (last run's bearish branch); (2) the 148.80 spring low was lost on a close on 11-19 and never reclaimed, CONFIRMED; (3) the 11-20 close below 140.76 (2024 range top) and the ~140 trendline is close #1 of a trap clock that runs through the closes of 11-23, 11-24 and 11-25. A reclaim needs about +12% (1w +10% touch rate 11.7%), so it is reachable but unlikely.

Fri 11-20: 633.4M shares, 3.9x the 60-day average (164.1M), a -14.01% bar closing 0.8% above its low. In a capitulation the close usually recovers off the low. Here it did not, so this was news-driven liquidation into the close (Reuters/SEC report, cross-domain). A Monday-Tuesday follow-through low under 124.14, then a reclaim, would be the classic trap/capitulation pattern.

The computed linear fibs (10.81 → 243.37) match the chart labels: 0.5 = 127.09, 0.382 = 99.65, 0.618 = 154.53, 0.65 = 161.97/161.98. The log scale puts 0.786 at 124.98, right on the 200W SMA 124.14 and Friday's low 124.50. That makes 122-128 a four-way confluence (two fib conventions, the 200W SMA and the actual low). It is the one place where a fib lines up with independent structure. The 0.382 at 99.65 lines up with swing 97.40, the next real confluence.

Two open gaps: 143.725-145.71 (new, Fri) and 179.92-185.22. Both sit overhead and should act as resistance on the first retest. The old L3 zone (141-145) now sits inside the new gap and under the broken 140.76/~140 trendline, so it has flipped from support to resistance.

Touch rates: 2w -10% 17.5 / -20% 2.5 (unreachable) / +10% 26.1; 1q -20% 23.1 / -30% 8.9. Engine reach checks for every ladder and trigger level are in notes_for_chair. Every trigger I list is between 5% and 95% in its window.

tv_technicals 1W/1D/4H are marked stale/partial: the TradingView MCP was down, so oscillators were read from the owner's chart and MAs/ATR were computed from daily and weekly data (the SMA200W matches the chart at 124.14). Read after event_cutoff_utc 2026-11-20T21:00Z on completed bars. What this costs: (a) no ADX, the key read on whether the trend is exhausting or accelerating (last run 41.5); (b) no CCI/AO or Buy/Sell summary to cross-check the oscillators; (c) no 4H moving averages except the 200. The momentum read is still solid, but trend strength is unknown. Options positioning is deferred, so put walls near 120/125 are unknown. I lowered confidence from 40 to 35.

key_levels.why: 100W SMA (price is -28.3% below it). The breakout tranche needs a reclaim of it. 8.0% reach by 2026-12-31, 36.1% by 2027-03-31.

Top of the new gap 143.725-145.71 (Fri high / Thu low). A daily close above it fills the gap and reclaims the 2024 range top and trendline: the first structural repair. 8.0% reach in 2w, 33.9% by 12-31.
2024 range top, plus the dotted 2023 trendline (~140). Broken on the 11-20 close; the trap clock runs through the 11-25 close.
Quarter up threshold, just under the 140-145.7 resistance band.
2w up threshold; a close above it would be the first sign the bounce has legs (50.2% touch by 12-04).
Linear fib 0.5, the top of the support cluster. A weekly close back above it with a lower wick would be the first weekly rejection of lower prices.
Friday's low and the week's low. A break and reclaim within 1-3 closes would be a trap (bullish).

200W SMA, the long-term trend line (price is +1.1% above it). It rises each week. Trap rule applies: a close below that is reclaimed within 1-3 daily closes is a trap; 2+ closes below 122 without a reclaim confirms the break.
Quarter down threshold, about one daily ATR below the 200W SMA. This is an ATR-derived level; no structure in the slice sits between 124 and 99.65.
Linear fib 0.382, with swing 97.40 just below: the next real confluence under the 200W (-20.6%). Unreachable in 2w (1.5%); 10.1% by 12-31, 27.4% by 3-31.
Swing label; with 86.62 it marks the deep zone. Unreachable by 12-31 (3.3%); 20.5% by 3-31.

what_would_change_my_mind: Bullish trap at the 200W: a daily close below 124.14 that is reclaimed (close back above 124.14) within 1-3 daily closes, by 2026-12-04 (122 touch rate 57.1%). This is the capitulation-and-reclaim pattern. I would move next_2_weeks to about 45/27/28 and next_quarter up to about 50.
Bullish trap at the range top: a daily close back above 140.76 by the 2026-11-25 close (1w +10% touch rate 11.7%) would mark Friday's breakdown as a trap. I would move this_quarter up above 45.

Bullish, 2w: a daily close above 131.81 by 2026-12-04 (50.2%) would lift 2w up above 50. A further daily close above 145.71 by 2026-12-31 (33.9%) fills the gap and would lift this_quarter up toward 50.

Bearish, confirmed break: two or more consecutive daily closes below 122 with no reclaim of 124.14 within three closes, by 2026-12-04 (122 touch rate 57.1%). I would move 2w down above 50 and this_quarter down above 45, and treat 112.98 and then 97.40-99.65 as the path.
Bearish, quarter: a daily close below 112.98 by 2026-12-31 (36.4%) would put next_quarter down above 40 and make the 97-100 confluence (10.1% reach by 12-31) the live target.

Weekly: a completed weekly bar (11-27 or 12-04) closing back above 127.09 with a lower wick at least 2x its body would be the first weekly rejection of lower prices: +5 to up on both quarters. A second full-body red weekly close below 124.14 would do the reverse.
notes_for_chair: Expected (not triggers): weekly closes 2026-11-27 and 2026-12-04 (the 2w bucket resolves at the 12-04 close); the late-Feb 2027 earnings (date not confirmed) fall inside next_quarter. Only their outcomes are triggers.

Before vs after earnings: the 11-17 print is past. It beat, the stock fell, and the 11-20 leg was news-driven (cross-domain). Until the late-Feb 2027 print, price is driven by levels, the trap rule and the governance/SEC story, not the business. The next_2_weeks and this_quarter buckets resolve before that print. next_quarter straddles it, and that is one reason its range bucket is only 25.

Last run scored against itself (for the lessons log): on 11-15 I put 2w down at 36 with 'close below 148.80 → test of L3 141-145, then 200W 123.6-127' as the bearish path. Price went straight through L3 to the 200W in one week, which is the down bucket (close 125.53 < 154.71). The direction was right, but I underestimated speed: the move covered three ladder levels in five sessions.

PROPOSAL ONLY: technical ladder update for the owner. Nothing here places, suggests executing or approves an order. Status: PROPOSED 2026-11-11, budget null, levels never approved or placed. Any thesis-break pause (TB2 per the brief) pauses all buying regardless of levels; whether it applies is the chair's call. Ladder Audit rows are never removed, so the old L1-L3 stay in the history as 'dropped (proposed, never placed)' if the owner agrees.

Proposal, old L1 162-164 and L2 154-157: DROP them as buy levels. They are 29.8% and 23.9% above price, and both anchors broke on confirmed closes (164.27 on 11-13 and 154.53/148.80 on 11-18/19, none reclaimed in 3 closes). They are now resistance. Reach by 12-31 for the +23-30% moves is under 10%.

Proposal, old L3 141-145: CONVERT it from a dip-buy into a confirmation (reclaim) tranche. Trigger: a daily close above 145.71 (gap filled, 140.76 range top and ~140 trendline reclaimed). It is 16.1% above price; reach 8.0% by 12-04, 33.9% by 12-31, 59.2% by 2027-02-24. Suggested weight 1.0 (it buys strength, so a worse average for less risk of catching a broken trend). Keep the existing breakout tranche (weekly close above 186; 2.7% reach by 12-31, so unreachable this quarter; 32.5% by 3-31).

Proposal, new N1 = old L4 narrowed to 122-127: anchors are the 200W SMA 124.14 (rising weekly), log fib 0.786 124.98, Fri low 124.50 and linear fib 0.5 127.09. This is the strongest anchor quality in the ladder (four-way confluence, the one place a fib meets structure). Price is inside it (128 touch 73.8%, 122 touch 57.1% by 12-04), so it fills before the Feb earnings almost surely if placed. Suggested weight 2.0, down from 3.0: the weekly and daily bars closed on their lows with no demand shown, so do not put the heaviest weight on the first level tested in a full-body breakdown. Technical preference: split it, half resting at 122-127 and half conditional on the trap rule (a close back above 124.14 after a close below it, within 1-3 closes).

Proposal, new N2 = 110-114 (ATR-derived, WEAK anchor): about one daily ATR below the 200W (124.14 - 10.71 = 113.43), bracketing the quarter down threshold 112.98. There is no horizontal structure or fib in the slice between 124 and 99.65; I flag this openly. Reach: 113.43 is 37.7% by 12-31 and 52.3% by 3-31; 110 is 11.4% by 12-04, 28.5% by 12-31 and 43.4% by 3-31. Likely to fill before the Feb earnings if the 200W breaks. Suggested weight 1.5. Spacing from N1 mid: about 10% = 1.2 ATR.

Proposal, new N3 = 97-100: linear fib 0.382 99.65 plus swing 97.40. This is a strong, structural confluence and the next real support below the 200W. Reach: 99.65 is 1.5% by 12-04 (unreachable in 2w), 10.1% by 12-31, 23.0% by 2-24 and 27.4% by 3-31; 97.40 is 7.9% / 20.2% / 25.9%. A capitulation level, more likely around or after the Feb print than before year-end. Suggested weight 3.0 (best anchor-to-price ratio). Spacing from N2 mid: about 12% = 1.4 ATR.

Proposal, new N4 = 86-91: swings 90.69 and 86.62 (structure only, no fib). Unreachable by 12-31 (90.69 3.3%, 86.62 2.2%); 13.0%/8.8% by 2-24 and 20.5%/15.5% by 3-31, so effectively a post-earnings, tail-scenario level. Suggested weight 2.0. Spacing from N3: about 11% = 1.3 ATR. Below 86.62 the next fib is 0.236 at 65.69, out of reach (not proposed).

Spacing logic: at ATR 10.71 (8.5%), a gap under one ATR makes two levels act as one (the old L1/L2 at 4.8% both traded through in one day, which proved it). The proposed gaps are about 1.2-1.4 ATR (10-12%). Weights proposed: confirm 1.0 | N1 2.0 | N2 1.5 | N3 3.0 | N4 2.0 (9.5 total; 3.5 of the 8.5 dip weight sits in levels likely to trade before 12-31). These weights are a technical view only. Sizing and budget belong to the owner and chair.

Weekly RSI: this time it IS oversold (25.01 < 30, completed bar). Do not over-read it. The ≤36 conditional is bimodal at 13w (69 up / 0 range / 31 down), and the Apr 2025 low came at 35.7, so oversold is neither necessary nor sufficient for a low.

Cross-domain: the 11-20 leg came from a Reuters report of SEC staff examining potential accounting issues. Technically it produced a full-body, close-at-the-low bar, which is how an information shock looks, not a positioning flush. Whether it touches TB1/TB2 or the thesis is for the narrative member and the chair. I treat it as a variance widener and as the main reason I do not lean bullish despite RSI 25.

Missing evidence: no ADX/CCI/AO/summary (MCP down), options positioning deferred, sentiment pages stale. The Equity Bottom checklist is a draft and not back-tested; the BBPCT triangles of Nov 10-13 already failed once.

Pre-mortem: if this is badly wrong in three months, the likeliest reason is that Friday's 124.50 on 3.9x volume at the 200W SMA with weekly RSI 25 was the low, and I under-weighted a once-in-years oversold reading. The alternative is that the accounting story turned into a thesis break and the 200W SMA failed, taking price to 97-100.
